Puzzle Lab preview

A preview of Teacher Ronny’s Puzzle Lab. It pretends to be the server: you start with 1,000 points, the names on the Hall of Legends are samples, and nothing here touches the real site. “Wake every monster” opens Killer Mode for every puzzle.

Inside: the 12 Puzzle Lab puzzles and Killer Mode that go live after the Armory, plus all 16 new class puzzles on the “Your class” shelves. Precalc A: Shape Shifter, Zero Hero, Asymptote Architect, Emoji Systems, Conic Catcher, Marble Logic. Precalc B: Logdoku, Log Links, Growth Catcher, Dartboard Rooms, Sine–Cosine Crossword, Unit Circle Constellations, Wave Catcher, Arc Links, Triangle Webs, Vector Golf.

On the real site this button returns to the Fun Zone.
